reader.requirement: At --std 85, when an examination meets two contiguous delimiters (no characters between them), the current receiving area is space-filled if alphabetic or alphanumeric (a group included) and zero-filled if numeric, for every receiver SR3 admits (alphabetic, alphanumeric, numeric display without P, any sign form or scale).
reader.edition-search: grep 'Edition|CobolVersion|Std|Dialect|Construct' over StringUnstringBinder.cs (only ctx.Edition as the diagnostic sink for BoundRejected/BoundOperandError reports, no switch); 'Edition|Version|Dialect' over StringEmitter.cs and CobolStringOps.cs (no hit); 'DialectLevel' over MoveEmitter/MoveBinder (only AllLiteralNumber, for an ALL-literal source, not the UNSTRING conceptual item, and file-record phrases); VersionConformancePass.VisitUnstringStatement gates only SR7 (reference-modified sender, Constructs.UnstringSenderReferenceModified2002). The general-rule path consults the edition nowhere; the probes print the same at --std 85 and --std 2023.
reader.witnesses-cover: part: pb3226_unstring_symbolic_delimiter and pb979_unstring_receiver_size cover alphanumeric receivers; numeric receivers with separate and overpunched signs and scale, alphabetic, JUSTIFIED, group, subscripted receivers and DELIMITER IN/COUNT IN alongside are not exercised

reader.notes: BindUnstring binds a ZERO-figurative MOVE for every receiver DESCRIBED as numeric (BoundUnstringReceiver.ZeroFill) beside the MOVE of the conceptual alphanumeric item; the emitter takes the zero-fill arm when the examined count is 0, and the MOVE of the empty alphanumeric item space-fills the others. No edition switch on the path; probes identical at --std 2023.
